name: Attune with the Winds puts a buff counter on each ally you control
notes: Attune with the Winds' element is WIND, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real WIND champion (Spirit of Wind) to unlock element access, reused from rally-the-peasants-search-human. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 3-reserve cost is paid, then both players decline the EffectStackActiveResponse opportunity window. The seeded Dungeon Guide is the only ally on the field and gets a buff counter. The [Class Bonus] Harmonize extra draw is out of scope since no Melody card was activated this turn.

rulesClauses: Put a buff counter on each ally you control.
